title: What is left of a drowned valley
text: Of the natural land that once covered this valley floor, generally less than five percent is left, broken into scattered pieces. One of the surviving pieces is Kern National Wildlife Refuge, {distance} from here, about eleven thousand acres of desert upland, old riverside woodland and marsh. It sits on the southern edge of what was once the largest freshwater wetland in the western United States, Tulare Lake. It was set aside in November 1960 to give migratory birds, above all ducks and other water birds, somewhere to spend the winter.

s6.title: Kern National Wildlife Refuge: About Us
